Abstract: Existing multimodal reasoning approaches predominantly follow two paradigms: converting visual inputs into text prior to reasoning, or performing end-to-end reasoning within a unified vision-language representation space. title: Learning When to Optimize: Verified Optimization Skills from Expert GPU-Kernel Lineages
summary:
